text: Auto Eder GmbH (Kolbermoor, Bavaria) is a family-led car-dealer group whose named managing partners (geschäftsführende Gesellschafter) are Peter Eder and Josef Eder.
short: Auto Eder is the Eder family business; managing partners Peter Eder and Josef Eder.

source.name: Auto Eder — Unsere Philosophie und Werte
source.quote: Peter Eder & Josef Eder - Geschäftsführende Gesellschafter
